envBackup.title: Environment Variable Backup & Restore
envBackup.selectHint: Select a backup to preview the diff
envBackup.confirmRestore: Restore environment variables using this diff?
envBackup.conflictTitle: Variables changed externally since the backup
envBackup.conflictHelp: The variables below were modified by another process after this backup was taken. In the default mode the restore aborts as a whole and the registry is left unchanged.
envBackup.forceConfirm: Overwrite these variables anyway? Overwritten variables are not backed up again and their current values will be lost.
envBackup.failedTitle: The following variables failed to restore
envBackup.deleteWarning: These variables will be deleted from the registry (the least reversible operation)
envBackup.deleteWarningHint: Deletion does not go to the Recycle Bin, and the restore process creates no new backup.
envBackup.adminRequired: Restore requires administrator rights: it opens the system hive with write access first. Restart PathEditor as administrator and try again.
envBackup.manualFallback: Restore never creates a new backup. To preserve the current state, back it up manually first:
envBackup.noDiffHint: The backup matches the current environment variables; restoring changes nothing.
envBackup.modifiedAlwaysZero: "Modified" is always 0: a changed value means the backup is stale and is counted as a conflict (design doc K3).
envBackup.forceUnderreport: Note: under force overwrite, variables replaced because of a conflict are still counted as conflicts, so the change count shown here is an underestimate.

envVar.name: Name
envVar.protectedHint: Built-in system variable, modifying it may cause system instability
envVar.deleteConfirm: Delete variable {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
envVar.varGone: This variable no longer exists (possibly deleted by another process). Refresh the list.
envVar.staleReloaded: The variable was modified externally. The latest value has been reloaded; please review before saving.
envVar.revealFirstHint: Click "Show" to view the current value before editing

code._comment: Fallback copy localized by CoreError code. Purpose: shown only when message is missing/empty (the normal path prefers the raw message — a complete user-facing sentence), and serves as the anchor for future per-code branches (e.g. conflict guidance, permission requests). Programmatic branching must check code, never match this copy.
code.conflict: The variable was modified by another process. Refresh and retry.
code.protected: Built-in system variable; it cannot be modified or deleted.
code.reservedName: This name is managed by the dedicated PATH channel; edit it in the PATH view.
code.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
code.nameExists: A variable with this name already exists; use the edit function.
code.notFound: The target variable no longer exists; refresh the list.

help.content:
PathEditor v{{version}} — Windows System Environment Variable (PATH) Editor

Features:
• Create/Edit/Delete path entries
• Move Up/Down to adjust priority
• One-click cleanup of invalid & duplicate paths
• Import/Export JSON, CSV, TXT formats
• Full Undo/Redo support

Shortcuts:
• Ctrl+N New
• Ctrl+S Save
• Ctrl+Z Undo
• Ctrl+Y Redo
• Ctrl+F Search
• Delete Delete selected
• F1 Help

Author: 刘航宇
GitHub: https://github.com/LHY0125/PathEditor
